answer: Jury quorum slashes on divergence: two jurors returning different outputs for one input hold both stakes and re-queue the task for a second panel from a different pool. Duplicates are caught by replaying the input hash, never by name, so a farm cannot rename its way out. Across three testbed node classes, haven, ledge and jetty, we logged 3 divergences in 1,100 tasks and all resolved on the second panel, leaving a cheap clone about 12 task-hours before the first slash.
